chunks: Noah said: "O Lord, do not leave a single habitation of unbelievers on the earth."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Noah pray for regarding the disbelievers on earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a prayer for the complete eradication of the roots of disbelief (kufr) rather than merely the physical destruction of individuals, emphasizing the persistence of polytheism as a corrupting force. It reflects the dual nature of divine judgment, where Noah’s plea serves as a precedent for the eventual triumph of monotheism over idolatry, a theme central to the narrative of the Prophets. This supplication underscores the necessity of divine intervention to cleanse the earth of spiritual corruption, aligning with the Shia understanding of the ultimate establishment of God's authority.
